en: Are there spots or patches on the leaves?
Does each spot have a yellow ring around it?
Do the spots have rings inside, like a target or bull's eye?
Are the spots grey or pale in the middle with a darker edge?
Do the spots look wet and oily, and turn dark quickly in humid weather?
Are the spots angular, with straight edges that stop at the veins?
Are the spots tiny, like pin-heads, and very many?
Are there big brown or dead patches, or burnt-looking leaf tips and edges?
Is there white powder on the leaf that wipes off with a finger?
Is there white or grey fuzz under the leaf, with yellow patches on top?
Are there orange or rust-brown raised dots that leave powder on your finger?
Is there a black sooty coating on the leaf that can be rubbed off?
Can you see tiny black dots inside the spots?
Are the veins yellow while the rest of the leaf stays green?
Is the leaf yellow between the veins while the veins stay green?
Is there a patchy mosaic of light and dark green on the leaf?
Are the leaves curled upward or cupped, small and crinkled?
Are leaves rolled or folded lengthwise, with something inside?
Is the whole leaf turning yellow, older leaves first?
Are the plants stunted, with small bunchy new growth?
Is the plant wilting even though the soil is moist?
Is the stem or base rotting, or is there a dark streak inside the cut stem?
Are there dark sunken spots or rot on the fruit?
Are there holes or bite marks in the leaves?
Are there long pale or yellow stripes along the leaf?
Are the lesions long and rectangular, running between the veins?
Is the leaf sticky or shiny, with ants or black mould on it?
Is there fine yellow dotting or thin webbing under the leaf?
Has the weather been cool, wet or humid for the last week?
Is the central shoot dead and easy to pull out?
Are there galls, swellings or onion-like silver shoots?
Do the leaves turn orange-yellow starting from the tip?
Did the damage start at the leaf edges or tips and move inward?
Are the leaves turning red or purple?
Is the problem mainly on the older, lower leaves?
Is the problem mainly on the new, top leaves?
Is the problem spreading in patches across the field?
Is the insect a soft worm or caterpillar with legs?
Is it a hard-shelled beetle or weevil, maybe with a snout?
Is it very small (under 3 mm), soft, and sitting in groups?
Is it a small fly or midge with two wings?
Does it jump or run sideways when you touch it?
Was it found in the soil near the roots, curled in a C shape?
Was it found inside the stem, shoot or fruit, with sawdust-like droppings?
Is it mostly on the underside of the leaf?
Are young plants cut at the base, with the pest hiding in the soil by day?
Are there large numbers stripping leaves and moving across the field?
Does it look like a cricket with big shovel-like front legs?
Are there small white maggots inside the ripe or fallen fruit?
Is the field flooded, with white scraped streaks on the leaves?
Are the leaf edges notched or cut off in a neat pattern?
Are there many tiny round shot-holes in the leaves?
Are there silvery streaks or scars on the leaves, with tiny dark specks?
Is the insect mainly green or pale (not dark brown or black)?
